# Sobhan Nami — Professional Profile & Advisory

> Sobhan Nami is a software engineer, architect, and technology leader. He serves as Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Ronika and Software Architect for ThingsPod (industrial IoT platform) and Dahir (smart aquaculture platform). He holds a Top Rank Master of Science degree in Secure Computing from Shiraz University and is an IEEE author on IoT routing security.

## Core Identity
- **Name:** Sobhan Nami (سبحان نامی)
- **Role:** Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
- **Company:** Ronika (Ertebat Sanat Ronika Pars)
- **Specialization:** Distributed Systems, Software Architecture, Industrial Internet of Things (IoT), Edge Computing, Secure Computing.
- **Academic Honors:** Top Rank Graduate M.Sc. in Secure Computing (Shiraz University), Top Rank Graduate B.Sc. in Software Engineering (Persian Gulf University).
- **Publication:** "Improving the Routing Protocol in the Internet of Things by Rule Extraction on Simulation Data", IEEE Xplore.

## Architected Platforms
- **ThingsPod (https://thingspod.io):** Industrial IoT platform for high-frequency telemetry, edge data processing, and large-scale device management.
- **Dahir (https://dahir.io):** Smart aquaculture automation platform utilizing acoustic feeding controllers and water-quality telemetry for marine farming.
- **Ronika (https://ronikapars.com):** Connected hardware, smart energy utilities, and industrial IoT solutions.
